name: clickhouse-cloud-whitelist-ip-action
description: GitHub Action to whitelist runner IP in ClickHouse Cloud with automatic cleanup

scripts.bundle: npm run build && ncc build dist/main.js -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && ncc build dist/cleanup.js -o dist/cleanup --source-map --license licenses.txt && mv dist/cleanup/index.js dist/cleanup.js && rm -rf dist/cleanup
scripts.all: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run bundle
